memos.argument: Heading 8538 covers parts suitable for use solely or principally with apparatus of 8535-8537 (motor controllers/starters are switchgear/control apparatus of 8535/8536/8537). Section XVI Note 2 routes parts of such apparatus to 8538. Molded plastic housings/covers have been classified here (J81348 molded plastic housings for electrical contacts at 8538.90.6000; F84705 plastic housing at 8538.90.8080; K86456 connector hoods/housings 8538.90.8080). HTS 8538.90.60 'Molded parts' fits molded plastic covers precisely, and Chapter 39 Note 2(s) pushes Section XVI articles out of ch.39.
exclusions_against: Section XVI Note 2 / parts rule depends on the cover being suitable solely or principally for 8535-8537 apparatus; a motor controller may be an electronic drive (8504) or a complete 8537 board, in which case it is a part of those instead
Facts missing: whether the controller is a switchgear/8537 article vs a static converter
Parts-of-Section-XVI chapter 85 notes (parts of electrical goods of 8504 would go elsewhere)

memos.argument: If the covers are generic molded plastic enclosures not dedicated to specific apparatus, 3926 'other articles of plastics' is the residual home (GRI 1; plastic is the constituent material). Rulings place plastic housings/boxes/lids here when not parts of machines (K85682 plastic lids/handles for filing boxes, 963502 clip-on plastic box).
exclusions_against: Chapter 39 Note 2(s) excludes articles of Section XVI (machines and electrical appliances, which includes parts under Section XVI Note 2), so a dedicated cover for a motor controller is excluded from 3926
Ruling hits for plastic covers on vehicles (G82813) went to the parts heading, not 3926
Nothing in ruling search shows a plastic cover for electrical control apparatus going to 3926

memos.argument: A motor controller (motor control center, 8537.10.60) is itself a board/panel/cabinet equipped with two or more 8535/8536 apparatus for electric control. If the plastic covers are imported as the enclosure of a controller or presented with it, or as a cabinet/base of 8537, the case for 8537 rests on R00385 (motor controller classified 8537.10.9060).
exclusions_against: Heading 8537 requires goods equipped with two or more apparatus of 8535/8536; empty covers are not equipped, and 8538.10 expressly covers bases not equipped with their apparatus (and covers are parts, 8538)
Covers alone are not the controller; no GRI 2(a) incomplete-article basis for a lone cover
8537.10.9160 not verified as an existing 10-digit code (8537.10.91 'Other' is the confirmed subheading)
